stops.note: roasted meat, verbal noun of kavurmak, to roast or fry
a Mughal court dish of meat braised in yoghurt and cream
Hindi-Urdu 'qorma' names the braising technique itself rather than a particular sauce
stops.meaning: a mild, creamy South Asian braised dish

current_meaning: a mild South Asian dish of meat or vegetables braised in a rich, creamy sauce
